purpose: Public static design and planning review only; no live orders or payments.

storefrontConcepts.purpose: Five separate design-review concepts using public product facts and original imagery. No live orders, payments, stock mutations or automatic live-design selection.

productPageConcepts.purpose: Five new product-page-only prototypes requested by the owner. Reuse already-approved public product facts and variant images. No home/store redesign or live design selection; no real commerce or inventory actions.

editorConcepts.purpose: Owner-requested Add / Edit product redesign prototypes with explicit variant archive, restore and delete actions. Guided and Variant desk remain memory-only; the separately approved Workbench extension stores bounded local text drafts. No real admin identity, SKU, stock, upload or mutation API. Preserve older review URLs. No live editor design is selected.

guidedRefinement.purpose: Owner chose direction 02 as the base for a new prototype with stable mobile navigation, a mobile preview modal and a card-to-product-page preview. Preserve previous comparisons and the live editor; fictional memory-only data and device-local photo previews, no backend or cart writes.

guidedScrollConcepts.purpose: Owner-requested guided prototypes comparing one page that scrolls both form and product together against a compact, non-scrolling preview with form-only scrolling. Visually verify with Playwright. Preserve previous studies, mobile pop-out detail preview and all live inventory boundaries; fictional memory-only data.

workbenchRefinement.purpose: Owner-requested improvements to direction01: screen-height Workbench, bounded customer/review rail, mobile preview modal and device-local autosave/restore. Only bounded editable prototype text/variant fields are stored, separately for Add/Edit; no photos, real inventory metadata, credentials or backend writes.

teamSprintPreview.purpose: Owner-requested website view for the cofounder. Publish only a general launch-preparation snapshot, with no private backlog, operational details, account data or editing.

pickupScheduling.purpose: Owner-requested draft plan and connected customer/operator pickup prototypes, using only fictional sites, dates, orders and example policies. In-memory hours, date exceptions, booking/conflict/reschedule and impact-review demonstrations; no private conversation, actual directions, customer data, checkout, inventory, notification or booking backend changes.

futureChanges: Review every public commit. This approval does not authorize secrets, customer data, buyer identity, confidential terms or private financial information.
